title: Vanilla Perfected
description: A compilation of Vanilla Plus mods & packs to perfect the Minecraft experience without drifting too far from the feel of the base game!
author: demonjoeTV
body:
# ![Vanilla Perfected!](/launcher-preview/bodies/1ocGzRHv/0.webp)
### Aiming to enhance Minecraft while retaining that Vanilla feel!

**Key Features: Drastically increased FPS, updated HUD and UI elements, Mob Animations, New Minecraft Dungeons inspired structures, QOL Updates, and much much more! (see Gallery tab for more insight)**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/lDPWSrttiec" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Thank you to Vanilla Tweaks for allowing the usage of their Resource Pack in Vanilla Perfected!**

**Credits:**
**Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/**

## Why the name Vanilla Perfected?

Vanilla Perfected was born after frequent comments from my subscribers on YouTube requesting that I make a modpack consisting of Minecraft mods that I use in my videos. This project is entirely driven by what I as a player like to use in Minecraft, and has never intended to be anything more than that. If you've ever wondered where the word "Perfected" comes from, it's in reference to this pack being the "perfect" version of Minecraft for me personally!

gallery.title: Complementary Shaders
gallery.description: Included with these shaders are my specific settings in order to replicate the exact look seen in my videos!

gallery.title: Dungeons and Taverns!
gallery.description: Adds endless new structures to all dimensions of Minecraft, many of which are directly inspired by Minecraft Dungeons!

gallery.title: I Like Vanilla Shaders
gallery.description: An optional Shader Pack that you can select if Complementary isn't your style! (pictured, but not featured in VP, is the mod Punchy)

versions.name: Wilderness Bound Update 26.3
versions.changelog:
## Vanilla Perfected Wilderness Bound Changelog

- Updated Vanilla Perfected to 26.3

- Updated VP's Custom Panorama

**New Additions:**

- Screenshot Gallery was added as an in-game method to track all your screenshots

- XP orbs now have particle trails thanks to the Elytra Contrails mod update

- Vanilla Perfected now starts with no shaders enabled for those with less powerful PC's. Many people play VP without shaders anyways, so I also added the Dynamic Lights mod for those that want dynamic lighting without needing shaders enabled. To enable shaders in-game simply press "i" and select between Complementary or I Like Vanilla.

- Vehicle Upgrade adds many QOL features to both Horses and Boats

- VanillaTweaks now features offset Shrubs & Bushes, as well as Visual Infested Stone Items

- The application is now titled "Vanilla Perfected: Wilderness Bound" instead of "Minecraft".. neato!

**Replaced Mods:**

- Armor Statues --> Armor Stand Poses
 
- Paginated Advancements --> Better Advancements

**Missing Packs:**

- Fresh Animations in an attempt to further optimize FPS for those with less powerful computers (you can always add it back yourself if you'd like!)

- Speed Happy Ghasts is not updated

- Explosive Enhancement was removed

**Known Issues:**

- None (at the moment!)

versions.name: Tiny Takeover Hotfix
versions.changelog:
## Vanilla Perfected Tiny Takeover Hotfix Changelog

**KNOWN ISSUES: Weird shield model with Enchantment Outlines. Disable the pack to disable the issue, but I hope to have it fixed soon!**

- Removed Fast Item Frames

This was done to prevent people from potentially losing their Item Frame items in the future. Fast Item Frames is a mod that isn't compatible with Vanilla, so playing on a world without the mod installed will cause your world's Item Frames and the items in them to disappear. Although I love this mod, I can totally see some people potentially losing their items due to not knowing this fact, and loading up an instance without this mod installed. **If you downloaded the first Tiny Takeover VP Update, make sure to double check all your Item Frames in any world you loaded up and remove them temporarily before updating to this version!** If you're like me and simply enjoy the mod, just re-install it after updating :)

- Added Fresh Buckets to go alongside Ben's Bundles!

versions.name: Tiny Takeover Update 26.1.2
versions.changelog:
## Vanilla Perfected Tiny Takeover Changelog

- Updated Vanilla Perfected to 26.1.2

- Updated VP's Custom Panorama

- Added BRAND NEW SHADERS: I Like Vanilla is an optional shader pack you can toggle instead of Complementary by either going to the Shader Pack menu in the video settings, or by pressing "O" in-game -- It comes with its own custom config and is attempting to replicate the Vanilla style as much as possible while adding subtle improvements like shadows, waving foliage, etc.

- Vanilla Tweaks now comes built-in with new features such as: 3D Bushes, unobstructive scaffolding, translucent pumpkin overlay, new stem textures for pumpkins and melons, variated firefly bushes, and circular log tops

- By popular demand, Vanilla Tweaks' Classic Netherite texture is a seperate OPTIONAL pack which can be found and enabled in the Resource Pack menu! (I totally get why some don't like it, but I love that classic look personally haha)

- C418 Songs Only is enabled by default at the top of the Resource Packs menu and can be switched off from there if you're not a nostalgia freak like myself

- Ben's Bundles was added to make bundles look 3D when holding them

- Animatica Refabricated is now here enabling custom animations in the GUI of the Recolourful Containers resource pack!

- Elytra Contrails mod has been added which also adds contrails for both Allays as they fly about, as well as arrows. Both Allay and arrow contrails can be disabled in the resource pack menu

- Better Block Entities has finally been added which should result in massive FPS increases for areas of your worlds that feature many block entities such as chests, signs, etc.

- Fast Item Frames has also been added! They can now be dyed the same way Leather Armor can be dyed, and are toggleable to be hidden or shown by sneaking and right-clicking

- The Day Count mod has been replaced with Day Count: A Day Counter HUD
- Cubes Without Borders has been replaced with Borderless Fullscreen
- Happy Ghasts Boost has been replaced with Speed Happy Ghast

- Due to being updated, Horseman mod has been re-added
- Elytra Trims has been re-added
- Visuality has been re-added

- Due to bugs the Lively Turtle Helmet resource pack has been removed for conflicting with other armor models
- AL's Piglins and Zombies Revamped have also been removed for non-updated baby mob textures (as soon as AL fixes this, they'll be back!)

- Current missing mods due to not being updated are: Crops Love Rain, Scholar, Text Formatting Everywhere
- Easy Shulker Boxes is also missing and has temporarily been replaced by Shulker Box Tooltips

- New general changes include Complementary Shaders now having built-in Glowing Ores and Glowing Armor Trims -- these can be disabled in the Materials settings if need be
- Complementary Shaders now feature Vanilla Clouds, and these can be changed back by going to ATMOSPHERE > CLOUDS > CLOUD STYLE
- Complementary Shaders brightness has been tweaked slightly
- The Tinker option of Axiom is now off by default to prevent confusion of Creative players

- Fixed a bug where Cave Lighting would change depending on the time of day
- Fixed a bug where Litematica information was popping up when pressing F3

versions.name: Update 1.21.10
versions.changelog:
## Vanilla Perfected Changelog 1.21.10

Now updated to **THE COPPER AGE UPDATE!**

Apologies for the late update, in-between this and 1.21.8 I was in the middle of moving houses, as well as planning for and getting married to my wonderful wife! I hope the wait didn't seem too long for you guys, and hopefully the Mounts of Mayhem VP update won't take nearly as long. Love you all, and shoot any bugs or feedback to me on Twitter / X at @demonjoeTV!

Important Note:

- All Mob-based Resource Packs have been replaced with non-Fresh Animations versions as Fresh Animations is bugged in 1.21.10 (specifically baby mobs and those with armor). This will be updated when fixed!

General Changes:

- Updated Shader water settings to look more vanilla

- Mojang Bootup Logo Background changed to black

- Added custom Vanilla Perfected panorama and splash text

Mod Additions:

- Simple Datapacks (auto-applies datapacks to brand new created worlds!)

- All Mob Heads Datapack (adds collectable Mob Heads that drop from Looting kills)

- Locator Lodestones (allows the Locator Bar to appear in single player via linking a compass with lodestone, this acts as a Vanilla Friendly waypoint system)

- Packed Packs (makes the resource pack menu much more intuitive)

- Immersive Hotbar (adds various hotbar related animations)

- Chat Animation (adds smoother animations when interacting with chat)

- Delete Worlds To Trash (worlds deleted will now be located in your recycle bin to help prevent permanent loss of worlds!)

- Cut Through (allows you to attack mobs through blocks like tall grass without being blocked and breaking grass instead)

- Boat Item View (maps held while rowing boats will stay visible now)

- Replaced Better Advancements with Paginated Advancements & Custom Frames

- Re-added World Play Time

- Re-added Entity Sound Features

Resource Pack Additions:

- Replaced Bray's Zombie Overhaul with AL's Zombies Revamped (it got a brand new Leader Zombies update!)

- Updated Vanilla Tweaks to feature variated Carved Pumpkin textures, HD End Flash, and Unique Painting Items

- Almost Vanilla Potions (unique potion models in line with vanilla MC)

- Dani's Oxidizing Copper Tools (copper tools will oxidize as they lose durability)

- Replaced PDB3D's Block Armor Stands with Fancy Armor Stand

- Fresh Flower Pots: Rotated Add-on

- Lively Turtle Helmet (an A&S inspired Turtle Helmet which looks amazing!)

- Minecarts with Wheels

- Pop-Out Clocks (place a clock in an item frame and it'll become a 3d Clock Model on your wall!)

- Roman Numerals for Enchant Icons

- Shelviety (updates the default bookshelf blocks to be more in-line with chiseled bookshelves)

- Weskerson's Torches removed due to DMCA reason, hope to have it back soon!

Missing Content:

- Removed No Resource Pack Warnings as this feature is already present in Packed Packs

- Tiny Item Animations, Horseman, and Subtle Effects are all missing due to not being updated as of yet
